lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 10 — Cornelius Calls for Peter

questions.questionText: I am a centurion in what was known as the Italian Regiment. Who am I?
Where did Cornelius live?
What kind of man was Cornelius?
options: Devout and God-fearing; he gave generously and prayed regularly

questions.questionText: About what time did Cornelius see a vision of an angel?
The angel said Cornelius’s prayers and gifts have come up as what?
The angel told Cornelius to send men to Joppa to bring back whom?
options: Peter, who is staying with Simon the tanner

questions.questionText: Whom did Cornelius send?
options: Two of his servants and a devout soldier

questions.questionText: About what time the next day was Peter on the roof to pray?
Peter became hungry and fell into what?
options: A deep sleep only without a vision

questions.questionText: What did Peter see coming down?
options: A large sheet with all kinds of four-footed animals, reptiles and birds

questions.questionText: A voice said, “Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.” What did Peter say?
options: “Surely not, Lord! I have never eaten anything impure or unclean.”

questions.questionText: The voice said, “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.” How many times did this happen?
While Peter was wondering about the vision, who arrived?
The Spirit said to Peter, “Three men are looking for you.” What should he do?
options: Get up, go downstairs, and do not hesitate to go with them

questions.questionText: Peter invited them in and the next day went with them to where?
When Peter entered, what did Cornelius do?
options: He fell at his feet in reverence

questions.questionText: Peter said, “Stand up. I am only a man myself.” Then what did he say about Jewish law?
options: It is against our law for a Jew to associate with or visit a Gentile
Jews must always eat with Gentiles

questions.questionText: Cornelius said, “We are all here in the presence of God to listen.” What had he gathered?
Peter said, “God does not show favoritism.” Who is accepted?
options: From every nation the one who fears him and does what is right

questions.questionText: Peter said God anointed me with the Holy Spirit and power. Who am I?
What did Jesus do after that anointing?
options: Went around doing good and healing all who were under the power of the devil

questions.questionText: Who raised Jesus from the dead on the third day?
Who did Jesus choose as witnesses who ate and drank with him after he rose?
While Peter was still speaking, what happened?
options: The Holy Spirit came on all who heard the message

questions.questionText: Who were astonished that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on Gentiles?
options: The circumcised believers who had come with Peter

questions.questionText: How did they know the Spirit was poured out?
options: They heard them speaking in tongues and praising God
They saw fire on the roof

questions.questionText: Peter said, “Surely no one can stand in the way of their being baptized.” Then what did he order?
options: That they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ
That they go to Jerusalem first

questions.questionText: What did they ask Peter to do?
options: Stay with them for a few days

questions.questionText: Peter was staying in Joppa with whom?
options: Simon the tanner by the sea

questions.questionText: True or false: Cornelius was a Gentile God-fearer, not a Jew.
I fell into a trance on a roof at noon. Who am I?
How many times was the sheet vision repeated?
I am a devout soldier who went with two servants to Joppa. Who am I?
Peter said, “God does not show _____. ”
Who told the people to preach to the people and testify that Jesus is the one appointed as judge?
options: Jesus commanded the witnesses to preach

questions.questionText: All the prophets testify that everyone who believes in him receives _____ of sins through his name.
True or false: Peter called the Gentile visitors “impure” and refused to go.
options: False — the Spirit told him to go without hesitation

questions.questionText: An angel in shining clothes stood in my house. Who am I?
How many days ago did Cornelius say he was praying when the angel came, counting to Peter’s arrival?
Simon the tanner’s house was by what?
